basic_info.description: Introducing a rare opportunity to own a stunning single-family home in the highly desirable Outer Sunset of San Francisco! This charming property features original hardwood floors throughout, blending classic style with modern potential. The open-concept kitchen, dining, and living room layout is perfect for entertaining, while the top floor offers two bedrooms and one bath, ready for your personal touch to enhance the space. Step out from the upstairs bedrooms onto a massive, newly reconstructed deck, ideal for enjoying morning coffee or relaxing evenings. The lower level boasts a beautifully remodeled primary suite with a spa-like bath and a spacious walk-in closet for ultimate comfort. You'll also enjoy partial water views on clear days, adding to the home's serene ambiance. Located in a fantastic, walkable neighborhood, this property is just minutes from Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, and several vibrant commercial corridors filled with top-notch restaurants, shopping, and local gems. Public transit is easily accessible, making this home as convenient as it is charming. Don't miss out on this hidden gem in one of San Francisco's most sought-after areas!
